rows.Origin: Bred by Michèle Meilland Richardier (France, before 2011).
rows.Bloom: Yellow, darker center, orange shading. up to 35 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, full (26-40 petals), in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 39" to 4'7" (100 to 140cm).
